messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the design critique 1: revoke flow and copy/reveal patterns feel confused in the current build. users expect a one-click copy near the masked key, not inside the kebab.
josh: Agreed. Revoke modal also steals focus then sends you back to the list without announcing success. keyboard users get lost.
rachel: proposal: inline copy icon visible on hover AND keyboard-focusable (tab index). show masked value by default `••••••••` and a separate "Reveal" affordance that opens an ephemeral dialog with the plain key + Copy CTA.
pradeep: security: reveal dialog should be one-time, not persistent; include a time-to-live (30s) and require `mfa:true` if policy says so. also log reveal events to audit.
maya: UX nit on the revoke confirmation copy: current text "Are you sure you want to revoke?" is ambiguous. suggest: "Revoke credential: this will immediately invalidate existing tokens. You can undo for 30s from the banner." add bold for "immediately invalidate".
josh: undo banner idea is good. show snackbar with "Credential revoked. Undo" that persists for 30s and is keyboard-focusable. if user tabs, banner should be reachable and `role=status` or `role=alert`? which is better for SRs?
rachel: recommend `role=alertdialog` for the undo because it needs keyboard focus and an explicit action. For passive status, `aria-live` polite on a banner is ok but not ideal for undo.
pradeep: ok use alertdialog. also: ensure tab order moves into the dialog after revoke; hitting Escape cancels and returns focus to the row.
mayan: (typo) maya: small accessibility detail: when reveal dialog opens, announce "API key revealed" via `aria-live=\"assertive\"` and include a visually-hidden copy of the key label so screen readers get context.
ux-bot: checklist generated: 1) add inline copy icon (hover + focus) 2) replace hover-reveal with Reveal dialog for non-admins 3) reveal dialog TTL 30s + auto-close 4) undo alertdialog with 30s timer and keyboard focus 5) update revoke microcopy and bold critical phrase 6) log reveal and revoke events.
infra-bot: FYI we'll gate the new reveal dialog behind flag `credentials_reveal_v2`. rolling a small canary on prod next week. no infra changes required.
josh: i'll update the focus management story in the PR and add e2e keyboard tests. rachel can you drop the copy variants for the modal and snackbar?
rachel: will post 3 copy options: terse, explanatory, and safety-first. leaning explanatory for product: "Revoke credential — this immediately invalidates tokens. You have 30s to undo."
maya: thanks. acceptance criteria: copy action reachable by mouse + keyboard, reveal requires explicit open with TTL and announcement, revoke displays undo alertdialog with keyboard focus, microcopy updated, events logged. i'll add to the ticket and assign tasks. :white_check_mark:
